why: A unit whose name TypeScript allows and Dafny reserves (label, print, map, type) is the Dafny function of its name with a trailing underscore, and its lemma is Equal_ of that name (Equal_label_): common.mjs dn names it for the translator, check.mjs and the suite alike. label makes the same outside call and writes its sum the other way round (proved through check.mjs, PASS-proved, where the old lemma name read ASK:unproved). print changes its brackets (not proved; lane B WITNESS on any input). map is untouched. type calls map with its own text unchanged (proved: map_ is the same function on both sides).
